acceptanceCriteria: Every inherited acceptance criterion is covered by #25/#26/#27; false success is rejected, effective repository gates exist after explicit approval, and merge eligibility/completion refer to the exact reviewed head.
nonGoals: No unapproved settings changes, direct merge, review bypass, project-runner redesign or automatic approval.
dependencies: #27 depends on #19, #25 and #26. #25 and #26 have no hard prerequisite. Release promotion #28 consumes #27's verification contract.
suggestedWorkBreakdown: Semantic validation #25 and repository policy #26 can advance independently. Current-head auto-merge #27 requires #19, #25 and verified policy #26; policy implementation can be tested with fakes before live gate availability.

subIssues.title: Reject contradictory implementation results and version validation receipts
subIssues.body: Make machine success mean passed validation and satisfied acceptance criteria without performing GitHub writes. See fully planned child #25. Factory suite on Windows/Linux; mutation fixtures for every contradictory and compatible case; schema checks of all updated producer examples.

subIssues.title: Configure and verify the dev review and auto-merge policy
subIssues.body: Provide the explicit repository-side review/check policy required by safe auto-merge, with human-approved settings and a verified receipt. See fully planned child #26. Read-only effective policy inspection first; after human-approved application use a controlled test PR, confirm rejection/eligibility without merging unreviewed changes.

subIssues.title: Bind auto-merge eligibility to the current reviewed PR head and observe completion
subIssues.body: Request auto-merge only for the intended dev PR at the exact independently reviewed and validated head. See fully planned child #27. Fake-gh cases for all denials, required-check/ruleset fixtures, changed-head race, valid allow case, queued merge then observed merge; full Factory suite.
